_comment: Example MCP server registry. Copy to $MINI_ORK_HOME/config/mcp_servers.json
and edit, or use `mini-ork mcp add`.
A node reaches a server by NAME (tools.mcp or mcp_servers: in workflow.yaml);
this file is the other half of that reference. Only servers a node is granted
are ever written into that node's .mcp-config.json, and the dispatch runs with
--strict-mcp-config, so nothing outside this file is visible to it.
NEVER put a credential here. Write ${NAME} and export NAME in
$MINI_ORK_HOME/config/secrets.local.sh (0600). An unset ${NAME} is a hard error
at dispatch time, not an empty header the node discovers mid-call.
Both shapes are accepted: Zed's editor shape (source/headers/oauth) and the
claude CLI shape (command/type/url). Editor-only keys are dropped, and OAuth
is not supported — provide a pre-obtained token in headers instead.
